title: nan
authors: Antonopoulos A.; Lagoudakis M.G.; Partsinevelos P.
key_contribution: Presents a ROS multi-tier UAV localization module integrating GNSS, visual, depth, and inertial data for real-time localization in GNSS-denied environments, tested in open, confined, and mixed spaces.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
